meta.name: Pluto TV Horror
meta.description:
Horror fans rejoice, your channel is alive. It’s a never ending fright-fest on Pluto TV Horror. Don’t turn on the lights, don’t answer the door, and don’t change that channel..

Shows: Scouts Guide to the Zombie Apocalypse, Crawl, Friday the 13th - Part III, Friday the 13th Part - IV: The Final Chapter, Friday the 13th Part V: A New Beginning
Available on: Pluto TV
